front.title: A Dual-Receipt Profile for Binding a Decision Statement to an Independent Policy Evaluation Statement

abstract.t: This document specifies a dual-receipt profile for recording one disbursement decision as two signed statements, made by two different parties and registered with the same Transparency Service. An approver acting for a fiscal sponsor signs a Decision Statement. A validator acting for a receiving institution signs a Policy Evaluation Statement that binds to the Decision Statement's identifier, receipt, and signature, and records the outcome of a named policy. The profile defines the JSON members of both statements, a canonical encoding based on the JSON Canonicalization Scheme, SHA-256 statement identifiers, a composite identifier, Merkle tree receipts that use the hashing rules of RFC 9162, and a verification procedure. It also states the limits of the evidence: a bundle of statements cannot show that no conflicting evaluation exists, and the times inside the statements are claims made by their signers.
